resources.string: Simple Tiresias for older people: few gestures, the volume keys and calling for help

Senior mode keeps Tiresias to the basics, for people who are starting out or only want the everyday things: few and easy gestures, the important things on the volume keys, short phrases and a help call. When you turn it off, everything is as it was before.
Changes the gestures, the Tiresias menu and what is spoken. It can be turned off at any time.
Senior mode off: everything is as it was before
Swipe one finger right or left to go from one thing to another. At the end, it starts again.
Double tap anywhere to open or press what was just spoken.
Swipe up to hear it again and down to know what you can do there.
Both volume keys together: to the Home screen, always. Hold volume up: the time, the battery and the notifications. Hold volume down: the Tiresias menu.
Volume up three times: call the help contact, with a few seconds to cancel by touching the screen. Volume down three times: tell it what you want.
Tap with two fingers to stop the speech.
